question: Train A leaves station M at 7:50 a.m. and reaches station N at 2:50 p.m. on the same day. Train B leaves station N at 9:50 a.m. and reaches station M at 2:50 p.m. on the same day. Find the time when Trains A and B meet.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let total distance = LCM(7, 5) = 35 units.

Speed of A = 35 ÷ 7 = 5 units/hr, Speed of B = 35 ÷ 5 = 7 units/hr.

Train A travels alone for 2 hours (7:50 a.m. to 9:50 a.m.), covering 5 × 2 = 10 units.

Remaining distance = 35 − 10 = 25 units. Relative speed = 5 + 7 = 12 units/hr.

Time to meet = 25 ÷ 12 hours = 2 hours 5 minutes.

Meeting time = 9:50 a.m. + 2 hours 5 minutes = 11:55 a.m.

**∴ The correct answer is 11:55 a.m.**
